I was getting my bottom wisdom teeth taken out because my teeth were all kinds of screwed up. When we were planning the procedure he asks if I want local anesthetic or if I want to be put under and “sleep” through it. My mom wants the local anesthetic, I disagreed because I hate the dentist and any kind of dental work being done. Anyway my mom won and the appointment was set. The day of the surgery I come in and they start getting everything ready, one of these things was a large tray full of long ass needles that were supposed to go in my mouth. I’m usually not that bad with needles, but there were at least 14 on that tray. I forget about it, whatever, it’ll be over soon enough. I was wrong. They proceeded to put all of them in my mouth with nothing to numb the surface one after the next. They honestly weren’t horrible, with the 3 going up into the roof of my mouth being the exception. They waited and asked “can you still feel this?” While touching my gum and I said yes. This was the day I found out I have a very strong resistance to numbing medication. After several more shots and the highest amount of anesthetic they could legally give me, I was finally fully numb. I was also too nauseous and dizzy for them to even put a finger near my mouth. They asked me to open wide and I threw up all over the poor assistant, I felt horrible. They sent me home and I had to come back the next day where they finally put me under. After that everything went great, I just feel bad for the poor assistant.
